analysis:
Market regime is UPTREND (SPY +4.1% 20d slope), which is constructive. However, the portfolio picture demands honesty before adding risk: 5 consecutive stop-losses, a profit factor of 0.66x, and a Sortino of -5.35 are serious warning signs. The book is already 79% deployed across 4 positions with only $15,989 of remaining capacity under the 95% gross cap — insufficient to size a new position to the 1–2% portfolio heat target on most candidates.

EXISTING POSITION REVIEW: (1) AMP +6.66% — thesis intact, quality compounder, but earnings 7/23 in 21 days; reduce or flatten into the print if momentum stalls. (2) LII +3.75% — HVAC demand is summer-seasonal tailwind, thesis intact, hold. (3) A +2.84% — small gain, life-sciences instruments recovering; thesis holds, hold. (4) CI -0.31% — essentially flat, managed care facing headline risk, NOT in today's screened candidate list which is worth noting; no confirmed thesis break but worth tightening mental stop and monitoring closely — exit if price closes below recent basing low.

CANDIDATE REVIEW: Most compelling screens have disqualifying issues given headroom constraints: SCHW (fwd PE 13.1, EPS revision +4.6%) has earnings in 19 days — too close to enter. AIG (fwd PE 8.61, FCF yield ~23%) is genuinely cheap but SMA50 slope is -0.5% with only $15,989 available — a properly sized 1% risk position would require ~$32k, exceeding capacity. ZBRA already produced a stop-loss in the recent period and is now +12% above SMA50 — extended per rules. HWM and MU are at 86% and 84% of 52-week range respectively — both disqualified as extended late-cycle. DHR earnings in 19 days, MA too large per share to fit in headroom with adequate sizing.

CONCLUSION: No new trades this cycle. The combination of constrained headroom (limits proper sizing), recent five-stop streak (market is not rewarding this timing methodology right now), and absence of any asymmetric setup passing all three gates — fundamental quality + confirmed technical base + adequate sizing room — argues strongly for patience. Holding the existing 4 positions which collectively show modest gains is the correct posture. Cash is a position. A quiet cycle protecting the +2.8% portfolio gain is a win, not a failure.
